findings.title: The light-theme value for post author links changes from 30% to 70% lightness, and the pair is reversed.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. Every other change in this PR keeps the old `$primary` value as the light branch and uses the complement for the dark branch. This line uses `(70%, 30%)` instead, so on every light theme the author names in `.topic-meta-data h5 a` become much paler. The dark-theme value is also off. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: The light-theme value for group member names changes from 30% to 50% lightness.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new light branch uses 50%, so `.group-member-info .name` becomes lighter on light themes and looks the same as `.title`. The request only asked to add a dark-theme variant. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: The mobile custom-message-length colour is reversed: light themes get 30% instead of 70%.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, and the desktop version of this rule correctly uses `(70%, 30%)`. Here the pair is reversed, so light themes show much darker text and dark themes get the wrong shade. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: The mobile topic-map h3 colour changes from 20% to 50% lightness on light themes.
findings.body: The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`, and the desktop version uses `(20%, 80%)`. The mobile light branch now uses 50%, so the h3 headings become paler on light themes and look the same as the h4 below them. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.title: The mobile light-theme value for group member names changes from 30% to 50% lightness.
findings.body: This is the same problem as in the desktop file. The old value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, and the light branch now uses 50%, which changes how light themes look. Fix: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.
